theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ), 1 ≤ n → ∀ (P : Submodule ℝ (Amb n ℓ)), Module.finrank ℝ P = n → ∀ s : ℝ, 0 ≤ s → ((μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)).restrict (P : Set (Amb n ℓ))) (closedBall 0 s) = ENNReal.ofReal (unitBallVolume n * s ^ n)
